text.purplenectar: 포니 화원에서 손에 넣은 꽃의 꿀. 특정 포켓몬의 모습을 바꾼다.
text.maxmushrooms: 다이맥스의 모습을 바꿀 수 있는 힘을 가진 버섯. 배틀 중인 포켓몬의 모든 능력을 올린다.
text.dynamaxcandy: 에너지가 가득한 사탕. 먹이면 다이맥스 레벨이 1 올라간다. 레벨이 높으면 HP가 늘어난다.
text.linkingcord: 통신교환으로 진화하는 포켓몬에게 쓰면 진화하게 하는 신기한 끈.
text.luckyegg: 행복이 가득한 알. 지니게 한 포켓몬은 받을 수 있는 경험치가 조금 늘어난다.
text.amuletcoin: 지니게 한 포켓몬이 한 번이라도 배틀에 나가면 돈을 2배로 받을 수 있다.
text.soothebell: 기분 좋은 소리의 방울. 지니게 한 포켓몬은 마음이 편안해져 친밀해지기 쉬워진다.
text.smokeball: 지니게 한 포켓몬은 야생 포켓몬과의 배틀에서 반드시 도망칠 수 있다.
text.luckincense: 지니게 한 포켓몬이 한 번이라도 배틀에 나가면 돈을 2배로 받을 수 있다.
text.cleansetag: 맨 앞의 포켓몬에게 지니게 하면 야생 포켓몬이 나타날 확률이 낮아진다.
text.pureincense: 맨 앞의 포켓몬에게 지니게 하면 야생 포켓몬이 나타날 확률이 낮아진다.
text.nugget: 금색으로 반짝반짝 빛나는 순금으로 만들어진 구슬. 상점에서 비싸게 팔린다.
text.bignugget: 금색으로 반짝반짝 빛나는 순금으로 만들어진 큰 구슬. 상점에서 비싸게 팔린다.
text.pearl: 예쁜 은색으로 빛나는 자그마한 진주. 상점에서 싸게 팔린다.
text.bigpearl: 예쁜 은색으로 빛나는 상당히 큰 낱알의 진주. 상점에서 비싸게 팔린다.
text.pearlstring: 예쁜 은색으로 빛나는 상당히 큰 낱알의 진주. 상점에서 비싸게 팔린다.
text.stardust: 감촉이 보슬보슬한 빨갛고 예쁜 모래. 상점에서 싸게 팔린다.
text.starpiece: 반짝반짝 빨갛게 빛나는 예쁜 보석 조각. 상점에서 비싸게 팔린다.
text.cometshard: 혜성이 가까워졌을 때 지표면에 떨어진 조각. 상점에서 비싸게 팔린다.
text.tinymushroom: 작고 진귀한 버섯. 일부 마니아 사이에서는 매우 인기가 높다.
text.bigmushroom: 크고 진귀한 버섯. 일부 마니아 사이에서는 매우 인기가 높다.
text.balmmushroom: 주변 일대에 좋은 향기가 퍼지는 희귀한 버섯. 상점에서 비싸게 팔린다.
text.relicgold: 3000년 정도 된 오랜 문명에서 사용된 금화.
text.rarebone: 포켓몬 고고학에 있어 매우 귀중한 뼈. 상점에서 비싸게 팔린다.
text.gimmighoulcoin: 모으령이 모으는 금색 코인. 많이 모으면 좋은 일이 생길지도 모른다.
text.prettyfeather: 아름답기만 할 뿐 아무 효과도 없는 지극히 평범한 날개.
text.repel: 사용하면 잠시 동안 약한 야생 포켓몬이 전혀 나오지 않게 된다.
text.superrepel: 약한 야생 포켓몬이 전혀 나오지 않게 된다. 벌레회피스프레이보다 효과가 오래간다.
text.maxrepel: 약한 야생 포켓몬이 전혀 나오지 않게 된다. 실버스프레이보다 효과가 오래간다.
text.escaperope: 길고 튼튼한 끈. 동굴이나 던전에서 빠져나올 수 있다. 몇 번이든 쓸 수 있다.
text.honey: 포켓몬이 모은 달콤한 냄새가 나는 꿀. 상점에서 싸게 팔린다.
text.teraorb: 포켓몬을 테라스탈시킬 수 있는 신비한 오브. 가지고 있으면 배틀에서 내 포켓몬을 테라스탈시킬 수 있다.
text.keystone: 메가스톤을 지닌 채로 싸우는 포켓몬을 메가진화시키는 미지의 힘을 가진 돌.
text.zring: 트레이너의 기력과 체력을 사용해서 포켓몬이 Z파워를 발산할 수 있게 하는 신비한 팔찌.
text.dynamaxband: 소원의별이 박혀 있으며 파워스폿에 있으면 빛이 나고 포켓몬을 다이맥스시킬 수 있다.
text.expshare: 스위치를 켜면 지닌 포켓몬 모두가 경험치를 받을 수 있는 장치.
text.oldrod: 낡고 조잡한 낚싯대. 물이 있는 장소에서 사용하면 포켓몬을 낚을 수 있다.
text.goodrod: 새로 나온 좋은 낚싯대. 물이 있는 장소에서 사용하면 포켓몬을 낚을 수 있다.
text.superrod: 최신식의 대단한 낚싯대. 물이 있는 장소에서 사용하면 포켓몬을 낚을 수 있다.
text.gracidea: 생일이나 기념일 등에 감사의 마음을 전하기 위해 부케로 만들어 보내는 일이 있다.
text.revealglass: 진실을 비춰줌으로 포켓몬을 본래의 모습으로 바꿔버리는 이상한 거울.
text.prisonbottle: 먼 옛날 어떤 포켓몬의 힘을 봉인했다고 여겨지는 항아리.
text.meteorite: 원래는 유성의 폭포에 떨어져 있던 운석이다. 굴뚝산에서 손에 넣었다.
text.dnasplicers: 원래는 하나였다고 전해지는 큐레무와 어떤 포켓몬을 합체시키는 한 쌍의 쐐기.
text.nsolarizer: 빛을 필요로 하는 네크로즈마와 솔가레오를 합체시키기 위한 머신.
text.nlunarizer: 빛을 필요로 하는 네크로즈마와 루나아라를 합체시키기 위한 머신.
text.reinsofunity: 인간들이 왕에게 바친 고삐. 풍요의 힘을 증폭시켜서 버드렉스와 애마를 합체시킨다.
text.rotomcatalog: 로토무가 좋아하는 가전제품이 실려 있다. 카탈로그를 사용하면 로토무를 가전제품에 넣거나 꺼낼 수 있다.
text.zygardecube: 포켓몬 지가르데의 코어와 셀이 모여있는 도구. 지가르데의 모습을 바꿀 수도 있다.
text.guardspec: 배틀 중 5턴 동안 같은 편의 능력을 떨어뜨리지 않게 하는 도구.
text.pokedoll: 포켓몬의 관심을 끄는 도구. 야생 포켓몬과의 배틀에서 반드시 도망칠 수 있다.
text.fluffytail: 포켓몬의 관심을 끄는 도구. 야생 포켓몬과의 배틀에서 반드시 도망칠 수 있다.
text.poketoy: 포켓몬의 관심을 끄는 도구. 야생 포켓몬과의 배틀에서 반드시 도망칠 수 있다.
text.blueflute: 파란 유리로 만들어진 피리. 잠듦 상태를 회복한다.
text.redflute: 빨간 유리로 만들어진 피리. 헤롱헤롱 상태를 회복한다.
text.yellowflute: 노란 유리로 만들어진 피리. 혼란 상태를 회복한다.
text.pokeflute: 잠자고 있는 포켓몬도 무심코 잠에서 깨어날 정도로 멋진 음색을 내는 피리.

textEn.rarecandy: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will instantly raise the level of a single Pokémon by one.
textEn.everstone: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A Pokémon holding this peculiar stone is prevented from evolving.
textEn.freshwater: Water with high mineral content. It can be used to restore 30 HP to a single Pokémon.
textEn.sodapop: A highly carbonated soda drink. It can be used to restore 50 HP to a single Pokémon.
textEn.lemonade: A very sweet and refreshing drink. It can be used to restore 70 HP to a single Pokémon.
textEn.moomoomilk: A bottle of highly nutritious milk. It can be used to restore 100 HP to a single Pokémon.
textEn.sweetheart: A piece of cloyingly sweet chocolate. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a single Pokémon.
textEn.energypowder: A very bitter medicinal powder. It can be used to restore 60 HP to a single Pokémon.
textEn.energyroot: An extremely bitter medicinal root. It can be used to restore 120 HP to a single Pokémon.
textEn.healpowder: A very bitter medicinal powder. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
textEn.revivalherb: A terribly bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon and fully restores its max HP.
textEn.sacredash: This rare ash can revive all fainted Pokémon in a party. In doing so, it also fully restores their max HP.
textEn.maxhoney: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also has the same effect as a Max Revive.
textEn.lavacookie: Lavaridge Town’s local specialty. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
textEn.oldgateau: The Old Chateau’s hidden specialty. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
textEn.casteliacone: Castelia City’s specialty, soft-serve ice cream. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
textEn.ragecandybar: Mahogany Town’s famous candy. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
textEn.lumiosegalette: A popular treat in Lumiose City. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
textEn.shaloursable: Shalour City’s famous shortbread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
textEn.bigmalasada: The Alola region’s local specialty—fried bread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
textEn.pewtercrunchies: Pewter City’s famous crunchy snack. They can be used to heal all status conditions of a single Pokémon.
textEn.hpup: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the HP base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.protein: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Attack base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.iron: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Defense base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.calcium: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Sp. Atk base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.zinc: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Sp. Def base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.carbos: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Speed base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.healthfeather: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the HP base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.musclefeather: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Attack base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.resistfeather: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Defense base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.geniusfeather: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Sp. Atk base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.cleverfeather: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Sp. Def base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.swiftfeather: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the Speed base points of a single Pokémon.
textEn.pomegberry: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly but lowers its HP base points.
textEn.kelpsyberry: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly but lowers its Attack base points.
textEn.qualotberry: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly but lowers its Defense base points.
textEn.hondewberry: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly but lowers its Sp. Atk base points.
textEn.grepaberry: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly but lowers its Sp. Def base points.
textEn.tamatoberry: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. Using it on a Pokémon makes it more friendly but lowers its Speed base points.
textEn.ppup: A medicine that slightly raises the max PP of a single selected move that has been learned by a Pokémon.
textEn.ppmax: A medicine that optimally raises the max PP of a single selected move that has been learned by a Pokémon.
textEn.expcandyxs: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very small amount of Exp. Points.
textEn.expcandys: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a small amount of Exp. Points.
textEn.expcandym: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a moderate amount of Exp. Points.
textEn.expcandyl: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a large amount of Exp. Points.
textEn.expcandyxl: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very large amount of Exp. Points.
textEn.abilitycapsule: A capsule that allows a Pokémon with two Abilities to switch between these Abilities when it is used.
textEn.abilitypatch: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

textEn.adamantmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Attack will grow more easily, but its Sp. Atk will grow more slowly.
textEn.naughtymint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Attack will grow more easily, but its Sp. Def will grow more slowly.
textEn.bravemint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Attack will grow more easily, but its Speed will grow more slowly.
textEn.boldmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Defense will grow more easily, but its Attack will grow more slowly.
textEn.impishmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Defense will grow more easily, but its Sp. Atk will grow more slowly.
textEn.laxmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Defense will grow more easily, but its Sp. Def will grow more slowly.
textEn.relaxedmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Defense will grow more easily, but its Speed will grow more slowly.
textEn.modestmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Sp. Atk will grow more easily, but its Attack will grow more slowly.
textEn.mildmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Sp. Atk will grow more easily, but its Defense will grow more slowly.
textEn.rashmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Sp. Atk will grow more easily, but its Sp. Def will grow more slowly.
textEn.quietmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Sp. Atk will grow more easily, but its Speed will grow more slowly.
textEn.calmmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Sp. Def will grow more easily, but its Attack will grow more slowly.
textEn.gentlemint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Sp. Def will grow more easily, but its Defense will grow more slowly.
textEn.carefulmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Sp. Def will grow more easily, but its Sp. Atk will grow more slowly.
textEn.sassymint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Sp. Def will grow more easily, but its Speed will grow more slowly.
textEn.timidmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Speed will grow more easily, but its Attack will grow more slowly.
textEn.hastymint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Speed will grow more easily, but its Defense will grow more slowly.
textEn.jollymint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Speed will grow more easily, but its Sp. Atk will grow more slowly.
textEn.naivemint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Speed will grow more easily, but its Sp. Def will grow more slowly.
textEn.seriousmint: When a Pokémon smells this mint, all of its stats will grow at an equal rate.
textEn.bottlecap: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a silver gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.
textEn.goldbottlecap: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a golden gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.
textEn.rednectar: A flower nectar obtained at Ula’ula Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
textEn.yellownectar: A flower nectar obtained at Melemele Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
textEn.pinknectar: A flower nectar obtained from the flowering shrubs on Royal Avenue. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
textEn.purplenectar: A flower nectar obtained at Poni Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
textEn.maxmushrooms: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.
textEn.dynamaxcandy: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will raise the Dynamax Level of a single Pokémon by one. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.
textEn.luckyegg: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s an egg filled with happiness that earns the holder extra Exp. Points in battle.
textEn.amuletcoin: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles any prize money received if the holding Pokémon joins a battle.
textEn.soothebell: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The comforting chime of this bell calms the holder, making it friendly.
textEn.smokeball: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to flee from any wild Pokémon encounter without fail.
textEn.luckincense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles any prize money received if the holding Pokémon joins a battle.
textEn.cleansetag: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the head of the party.
textEn.pureincense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the head of the party.
textEn.nugget: A nugget of the purest gold that gives off a lustrous gleam in direct light. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
textEn.bignugget: A big nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
textEn.pearl: A rather small pearl that has a very nice silvery sheen to it. It can be sold at a low price to shops.
textEn.bigpearl: A rather large pearl that has a very nice silvery sheen. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
textEn.pearlstring: Very large pearls that sparkle in a pretty silver color. They can be sold at a high price to shops.
textEn.stardust: Lovely red sand that flows between the fingers with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a low price to shops.
textEn.starpiece: A small shard of a beautiful gem that gives off a distinctly red sparkle. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
textEn.cometshard: A shard that fell to the ground when a comet approached. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
textEn.tinymushroom: A very small and rare mushroom. It’s popular with a certain class of collectors.
textEn.bigmushroom: A very large and rare mushroom. It’s popular with a certain class of collectors.
textEn.balmmushroom: A rare mushroom that gives off a nice fragrance. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
textEn.relicgold: A gold coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.
textEn.rarebone: A rare bone that is extremely valuable for the study of Pokémon archeology. It can be sold for a high price to shops.
textEn.prettyfeather: Though this feather is beautiful, it’s just a regular feather and has no effect.
textEn.repel: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while.
textEn.superrepel: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while. It lasts longer than Repel.
textEn.maxrepel: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while. It lasts longer than Super Repel.
textEn.escaperope: A long and durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from locations like caves or dungeons. It can be used any number of times.
textEn.wishingpiece: Throw one into a Pokémon Den to attract a wild Dynamax Pokémon.
textEn.honey: A sweet honey collected by Pokémon. It has a lush aroma and can be sold at a low price to shops.
textEn.keystone: A stone filled with an unexplained power. It makes Pokémon that battle with a Mega Stone Mega Evolve.
textEn.zring: A mysterious ring that enables Pokémon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.
textEn.dynamaxband: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out a light that allows Pokémon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.
textEn.expshare: Turning on this special device will allow all the Pokémon on your team to receive Exp. Points from battles.
textEn.oldrod: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
textEn.goodrod: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
textEn.superrod: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
textEn.gracidea: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions, such as birthdays.
textEn.revealglass: A looking glass that reveals the truth. It’s a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon to its original shape.
textEn.prisonbottle: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokémon long, long ago.
textEn.meteorite: A Meteorite originally found at Meteor Falls. You got it at Mt. Chimney.
textEn.dnasplicers: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.
textEn.nsolarizer: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Solgaleo.
textEn.nlunarizer: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Lunala.
textEn.reinsofunity: Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite Calyrex with its beloved steed.
textEn.rotomcatalog: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the various devices listed within.
textEn.zygardecube: An item in which Zygarde Cores and Cells are gathered. You can also use it to change Zygarde’s forms.
textEn.guardspec: An item that prevents stat reduction among the Trainer’s party Pokémon for five turns after it is used in battle.
textEn.pokedoll: A doll that attracts the attention of a Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.
textEn.fluffytail: A toy that attracts the attention of a Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.
textEn.poketoy: A toy that attracts the attention of a Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.
textEn.blueflute: A flute made from blue glass. It awakens sleeping Pokémon.
textEn.redflute: A flute made from red glass. It snaps Pokémon out of infatuation.
textEn.yellowflute: A flute made from yellow glass. It snaps Pokémon out of confusion.
textEn.pokeflute: A flute that can play with such a beautiful tone that even sleeping Pokémon find themselves woken up.

ko.expshare: 지니게 하면 배틀에 나가지 않아도 배틀에서 얻은 경험치를 나눠 받는다.

en.expshare: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder gets a share of a battle’s Exp. Points without battling.
